page.layout: One printed page. At the top, a decorative woodcut border. Below it, a centred italic dedication in several lines. Then six indented entries, each beginning with "DN." at the left and continuing to the right. Below these, a centred italic dedication line, then a right-aligned signature block with an imprint line.

p.i: Admodum Reverendis, Clarissimis, nec non Doctissimis Viris, studiorum suorum Fundatoribus ac Promotoribus, nullo non observantiæ genere prosequendis, colendis.

main_text.p: DN. DAVIDI ALBINO, SS. Theologiæ Professori Excellentissimo.
DN· SAMUELI HENZIO, Catech. Theol. ac Ling. Græcæ Prof. Celeberrimo.
DN. DAVIDI BOURGESIO, Phil. Theoret. Prof. Experientissimo, Rectori p. t. Magnifico.
DN. RODOLPHO RODOLPH, Linguæ Sanctæ & Phil. Pract. Prof. Acutissimo.
DN. JACOBO ANTH. VULPIO, Gymnasiarchæ Dignissimo, Avunculo suo Honoratissimo.
DN. JOH. PETRO MALACRIDA, Ecclesiæ, quæ colligitur in Wyll[?] / Pastori Vigilantissimo, Parenti suo omni filiali amore prosequendo.

p.i: Dissertationem hanc Philologicam summisse dedicat, offert

page.notes: The woodcut border at the top is an ornament and is not transcribed. Faint mirrored text on the left and right of the page (show-through from the other side, including large ghost capitals and the imprint "Georgius Schultes ... 1679" at the foot) is excluded. A digitiser's watermark near the bottom is excluded. "Wyll" is set with a decorative initial W and is uncertain. The "DN·" in the second entry is printed with a raised dot, which is copied as seen. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
